beats.name: hook
beats.said: A button sits mid-town and nobody may press it.
beats.shown: Guard and red-shirt man beside a red button on a pedestal; guard stoic, man sweating.

beats.name: setup
beats.said: Town built in circles around button, guarded, walled, with a dimming glow beyond the wall.
beats.shown: Fly-through of circular town, guard with mug, ladder up wall, glowing ring in night sky.

beats.name: escalation
beats.said: Gary notices 47 scratches under the glass and a statue woman resembling his mom.
beats.shown: Attic room, button with counter, guard, bronze statue.

beats.name: twist
beats.said: Friends bet five dollars; at 3am during guard swap he has seconds.
beats.shown: Three friends at railing holding a bill, night town aerial.

beats.name: payoff
beats.said: He presses it, nothing happens but a scratch sound; glow brightens as he walks home.
beats.shown: Gary at the glass dome, close-up of button, night street turning orange.

beats.name: ending
beats.said: Town vanished into a field; 48 scratches; his mom says build the town here.
beats.shown: Gary in grass, big crowd in field, counter at 48, mom beside crowd and button.

hook.first_frame: Guard in blue cap and red-shirt man behind a red button on a stone pedestal, town blurred behind, caption 'There's'.
hook.first_3s: Camera pushes in on the button; the man's grin turns to a worried face with sweat drop and clenched teeth; guard stays flat-faced.
hook.title_vs_first_line: Title restates the premise (town built around a button); first line introduces the button and the ban.

story.real_fact_core: No real fact; an invented fable of a taboo button, a forbidden act and a cycle where the town rebuilds around it.
story.protagonist: Gary, young man in red shirt with dark hair
story.authority_or_antagonist: Two guards and the wall; his mom as final authority

tone.humour: Light absurdity: five-dollar bet, mug-holding guard, mom lookalike statue; sweat-drop reactions.
tone.deadpan_or_irony: Deadpan narration of an unexplained eerie premise; no explanation given.
tone.dialogue_style: Narrator voice only; one reported line from mom at the end.
